findings.title: Stale proof artifacts: GIT_DIFF.patch / GIT_DIFF_STAT.txt / PATH_ALLOWLIST_CHECK.json / SECRET_SCAN.json captured against a 2-file uncommitted diff, not the final 104-file commit
findings.body: The auditor confirmed these four proof files were generated against a stale intermediate working-tree diff rather than the final 104-file/35314-insertion commit. Underlying outcomes (allowlist compliance, no secrets) independently re-verified as correct, but the proof files themselves misrepresented scope. Fixed by this repair: all four files regenerated against the true final diff (see fixes_applied).

findings.title: 05-independent-audit stage structurally absent: 4 required artifacts formally MISSING per MISSING-OR-MISMATCHED.json
findings.body: AUDITOR-FLEET-SYNTHESIS-AUDIT.md, AUDITOR-FLEET-SYNTHESIS-FINDINGS.json, REQUIRED_SYNTHESIS_REPAIRS.md, and AUDIT_HANDOFF_TO_SUPERVISOR.json were never physically supplied to the intake session. The packet instructions forbid creating meaningless empty placeholder directories, so the directory was correctly omitted rather than faked. Not a defect in this evidence-intake packet's scope; carried forward as a remaining risk.

findings.title: Repair session's own evidence-bundle lookup script produced a spurious empty-match warning
findings.body: A bug in the pre-audit evidence-preparation script (not the committed artifact) caused a false-positive warning during HASH_VALIDATION.json inspection. Direct field-level verification by the auditor confirmed the underlying committed data is correct.

findings.title: HASH_VALIDATION.json carries 21 PRESENT_UNACCEPTED entries alongside the 51 ACCEPTED entries
findings.body: 72 total entries (51 ACCEPTED + 21 PRESENT_UNACCEPTED). The 21 are correctly excluded from the committed accepted tree and are not mislabeled as ACCEPTED. No leakage detected.
